milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the green concrete structure and face toward it, confirming visual identification. The target [9, 0, 9] is the center of the 2x2x4 green concrete structure (blocks span x=8-9, z=8-9, y=-1 to 2 spawn-relative). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually approached the target (not just walked in the general direction), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it. The sandbox test confirmed the agent reached this distance within 20 steps.
